title: rubus hirtus var. callicarpus
intro: Rubus hirtus var. callicarpus, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry or Himalayan strawberry, is a plant species belonging to the Rubus genus. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, fever, and inflammation, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rubus hirtus var. callicarpus include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its ability to reduce swelling, protect against cell damage, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
